ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- if (payload is String) read(payload, "application/json") else payload

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var incomingMessage = if (payload is String) read(payload, "application/json") else payload --- { ackId: attributes.ackId, correlationId: (correlationId default uuid()) as String, contactId: incomingMessage.contact_sf_id default incomingMessage.contactId default incomingMessage.Id default "UNKNOWN", originalPayload: incomingMessage }

%dw 2.0 output application/java --- vars.messageContext ++ { failureRecord: { contactSfId: if (vars.messageContext.contactId == "UNKNOWN") null else vars.messageContext.contactId,
correlationId: vars.messageContext.correlationId,
errorMessage: error.description default error.detailedDescription default "Contact onboarding validation failed.",
originalPayload: write( vars.messageContext.originalPayload, "application/json" ) } }

db:insert.doc:name: Store Contact Onboarding Failure
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO contact_onboarding_failure ( contact_sf_id, correlation_id, error_message, original_payload, created_at ) VALUES ( :contactSfId, :correlationId, :errorMessage, :originalPayload, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

logger.doc:name: Log Stored Validation Failure
logger.message: #[write({ event: "CONTACT_VALIDATION_FAILURE_STORED", correlationId: vars.messageContext.correlationId, contactId: vars.messageContext.contactId, errorMessage: vars.messageContext.failureRecord.errorMessage, disposition: "STORED_AND_REJECTED" }, "application/json")]

logger.doc:name: Log Database Connectivity Error
logger.message: #[write({ event: "CONTACT_DATABASE_CONNECTIVITY_FAILED", correlationId: vars.messageContext.correlationId default correlationId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", contactId: vars.messageContext.contactId default payload.contact_sf_id default "UNKNOWN", description: error.description default "Database connectivity failed", disposition: "REQUEUED" }, "application/json")]

logger.doc:name: Log Retry Exhausted Error
logger.message: #[write({ event: "CONTACT_DATABASE_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED", correlationId: vars.messageContext.correlationId default correlationId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", contactId: vars.messageContext.contactId default payload.contact_sf_id default "UNKNOWN", description: error.description default "Database retries exhausted", disposition: "REQUEUED" }, "application/json")]

logger.doc:name: Log Connectivity Error
logger.message: #[write({ event: "CONTACT_CONNECTIVITY_FAILED", correlationId: vars.messageContext.correlationId default correlationId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", contactId: vars.messageContext.contactId default payload.contact_sf_id default "UNKNOWN", description: error.description default "Connectivity failure", disposition: "REQUEUED" }, "application/json")]

logger.doc:name: Log Expression Error
logger.message: #[write({ event: "CONTACT_EXPRESSION_ERROR", correlationId: vars.messageContext.correlationId default correlationId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", contactId: vars.messageContext.contactId default payload.contact_sf_id default "UNKNOWN", description: error.description default "Expression failure", disposition: "NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED" }, "application/json")]

logger.doc:name: Log Unexpected Error
logger.message: #[write({ event: "CONTACT_UNEXPECTED_ERROR", correlationId: vars.messageContext.correlationId default correlationId default "NOT_AVAILABLE", contactId: vars.messageContext.contactId default payload.contact_sf_id default "UNKNOWN", description: error.description default "Unexpected failure", disposition: "NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED" }, "application/json")]
